title: Mixed blood granulocyte geometry does not establish incremental airflow-ratio prediction across NHANES cycles
abstract: A nonlinear blood eosinophil–neutrophil surface changed transferred weighted FEV1/FVC MSE from 0.00463198 to 0.00464669 (delta +0.00001470; joint PSU bootstrap95% [-0.00002557,+0.00024925]); predictive improvement was not established. Exploratory transfer between separately recruited NHANES cycles, not untouched confirmation or external-study validation.
